0022600129.text: The Knicks (0-3) host the Detroit Pistons (3-0) in their fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with New York on a three-game losing streak and 13th in the East, 2.5 games back in the Atlantic. Detroit, first in the Central and first in the East, is riding a three-game winning streak, and Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain while Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. New York will be without Jose Alvarado, who is out with an ankle sprain, and the teams have not met yet this season after the Knicks lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-111 in New York on February 19, 2026.
